column1: # 16 MB layout. Dual app slots so OTA rollback works -- see net/ota.cpp for why
# that is not optional on a battery device inside a picture frame on a wall.
# 4 MB per slot is generous (the binary is ~1.4 MB) but keeps the arithmetic obvious.
# storage/ holds the cached .pfrm so a low battery or a mid-refresh brownout can be
# recovered from without erasing the photo that is already on the glass.
